opening.argument: The speaker explains a crypto-yield service through stated account choices and rates: viewers would deposit XRP, select an account type and earn interest at the rates described. A five-year return illustration expressly assumes a 15% APR yield and a starting balance of 25,000 XRP; it does not establish what any particular viewer will receive. Interested viewers are directed to a sign-up link, and the description discloses possible commission compensation. It also warns that crypto-assets are volatile, involve significant risk, and carry no guaranteed profits or outcomes. Those disclosures frame the presentation as promotional financial commentary, without establishing the service’s accuracy or safety.
